t: Frogtape Advanced Multi-Surface Masking Tape is engineered for professional painters and decorators, providing extra sharp paint lines and clean removal. This tape is ideal for intricate painting tasks on cured painted surfaces, wood trim, glass and metal, ensuring a professional finish. PaintBlock Technology seals tape edges, preventing paint bleed for crisp results. The tape offers 28-day indoor clean removal, utilising Nano Technology to maintain adhesive integrity. A thin, yet strong washi paper backing provides excellent conformability and tear-free removal, even around curves, making challenging projects manageable.
b: For Use on Cured Painted Surfaces, Wood Trim, Glass & Metal
Stronger than Crepe Tape & Removes without Tearing
